title: How should new surfaces start?
question: This is a workflow default for future Impeccable builds on click-web — not product truth. Comp-first: an image sets the bar before any code; bolder composition, slower, and the build must match the image. Code-first: build directly; the ambition is written into the direction contract and audited at the finish; leaner and faster. Which should be the project default?

options.label: Comp-first
options.thesis: Generate a high-fidelity image of the surface, approve it, then build code that matches.
options.body: Bolder composition and a harder finish gate. Slower. Use when the screen needs a new visual world or a replacement look, not a small refinement.

options.label: Code-first
options.thesis: Skip the image round. Write the ambition into the direction contract and audit it when the surface is built.
options.body: Leaner and faster. Better for extending the incumbent interface. Still a full design pass — just not image-led.
